manifestSelfExclusion: This file excludes its own bytes/hash to avoid a self-reference. Its staged blob is verified separately and its SHA256 and final commit are supplied in the PM handoff.
binaryPolicy: No native binary, archive, SDK, cache or private/product execution artifact is committed. Extraction inventories are metadata. All staged raw bytes match their unchanged owned files and every prior copy pin.
verificationScope: Documentation/custody checks only after the immutable independent execution. No additional build, test, original helper, native/private gate, app, CI or deploy run.
